  In the morning, after she had gone back with the tide, Tomas took the logbook down and opened it to a clean page. He
  wrote the date, and the wind, and the time the lamp was lit. Then, after a long moment, he added one more line in his
  careful hand.

  Lamp lit. Wind fair. Company.
